Each flowerpot snake is born from an unfertilized egg via "premeiotic endoreplication".  She's a genetic clone of her mother.  We call this 'parthenogenesis'.

And each cell in her body will have *3* copies of her genome, which is very unusual.

What we think happened:  about 41 million years ago...
